subject.title: North Orange County Community College District Board, Trustee Area 3

text:
My Top Priority, Student Success.
High-paying skilled jobs have been leaving California. One of the best ways to bring those jobs back is to build a highly trained workforce. That begins with education.
Not every student follows the same path. Some will earn a university degree. Others will build successful careers through career and technical education, apprenticeships, certificate programs, or workforce training. Hundreds of rewarding careers require education beyond high school, and every path deserves respect, support, and opportunity.
Our community colleges must prepare students for college transfer and high-demand careers. This means expanding career education, strengthening partnerships with local businesses, industry, labor organizations, and providing training that leads directly to good-paying careers.
California needs more skilled workers in construction, manufacturing, healthcare, technology, transportation, public safety, and many other essential industries. Our colleges must provide the knowledge, technical skills, hands-on experience, and problem-solving abilities employers need.
As Trustee, I will work with local, state, and federal elected officials to secure funding to build modern campuses, expand career training facilities, and provide the classes, equipment, and student support services needed for success.
Together we can build stronger students, stronger families, a stronger workforce, stronger communities, and a stronger California tomorrow.

text: I have been a resident of Orange County for 45 years and local small business owner for the past 35 years. I live in Buena Park with my daughters Paulina, attending Chapman University and Emily, attending Kennedy High School. I am currently employed by the Orange County District Attorney’s Office and have been working there for over 25 years. I am a graduate of California State University Long Beach with a degree in Public Administration and have applied it to my profession as a Safety Representative for Orange County, looking after the safety and well-being of many employees.

I have served as a Member of the Buena Park Planning Commission for over 8 years and Member of the Buena Park Traffic Commission for 8 years. I am a Tier II Volunteer for the Anaheim Union High School District, working with the Walker and Kennedy High School Show Choirs.
I am also a small business owner working for over 35 years at the Cypress College Swap Meet selling watch batteries and bands on Saturdays and Sundays.

Our community colleges are a tremendous benefit to our residents seeking further education, enhancing job training skills, and offering career changing pathways. I’ll work hard to ensure our colleges stay ahead of the rapidly changing demands of today’s society.

text: My experience working with community colleges, public policy, and local government will help guide our district through the challenges facing higher education while keeping students at the center of every decision.
As your community college trustee, I will work to:
Expand workforce development and career education programs that prepare students for well-paying careers while strengthening partnerships with local employers.
Address declining enrollment by reaching out to former students, adult learners, and working families, making it easier to return to college and complete a degree or certificate.
Support student success by expanding academic support, transfer opportunities, mental health resources, and basic needs programs that help students stay enrolled and graduate.
Champion first-generation college students by improving access to counseling, financial aid, and mentoring so every student has the opportunity to succeed.
Strengthen services for veterans by supporting programs that help them transition to college, earn credentials, and enter the workforce.
Ensure the district remains financially responsible while maintaining high-quality instruction and preparing students for the changing workforce of tomorrow.

As a UCLA graduate, former Fullerton College Student Trustee, and California higher education policy advocate, I have dedicated my career to expanding educational opportunity and helping students succeed.
